---
title: "Outreach & Teaching"
---

Materials from statistics workshops and short courses I've taught. Everything
here is free to reuse and adapt — slides, data, and code. If you teach from it,
I'd be glad to hear how it went.

::: {.note}
**EDIT:** Replace the workshops below with your own. Two practical notes:
host slides and data as files in this repo (`files/`) rather than linking to
Google Drive or Dropbox, both of which are blocked in mainland China — this is
the single biggest thing that determines whether your students there can
actually get the materials.
:::
